title: Fix `POST /api/v1/accounts` still being accessible when `SSO_ACCOUNT_SIGN_UP` is set
body:
Fixes #33696

`SSO_ACCOUNT_SIGN_UP` is suboptimal because it doesn't immediate authentication in the app; nevertheless, it's meant to *replace* the account sign-up flow, so `POST /api/v1/accounts` still working when that variable is set is a bug.
